goal: Keep local git worktrees made under .worktrees/ out of git status on the main checkout.

claims.claim: A file under .worktrees/ is ignored and does not show in git status.
claims.check: Created .worktrees/probe/f in a worktree at the commit, then ran git check-ignore -v on it and git status --porcelain -- .worktrees.

release.none: Repo hygiene only; nothing a user of this repo sees changes.
